mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ > 1.5%) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of quarters with GDPC1 QoQ growth exceeding 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signal restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high FEDFUNDS (>5.0%) and elevated CPI (CPIAUCSL > 310) indicate persistent inflationary pressures and aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases when both FEDFUNDS >5.0 and CPIAUCSL >310.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 310), rising consumer price pressures reduce real disposable income, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day returns as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods with CPIAUCSL exceeding 310.

mechanism_narrative: Declining monthly payrolls (PAYEMS < 158,000) signal labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where PAYEMS falls below 158,000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 1300) indicate strengthening consumer demand for durable goods, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through improved retail sales and manufacturing activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months with HOUST exceeding 1300.

mechanism_narrative: Falling industrial production (INDPRO < 101) reflects weakening manufacturing output, signaling economic contraction and negative S&P 500 60-day returns as corporate revenue growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of quarters with INDPRO below 101.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 690,000) and housing starts (HOUST > 1300) confirms robust consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns through sustained corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where both RSAFS > 690,000 and HOUST > 1300.
